title: Kra–Dai-speaking peoples - Wikipedia
text: The term Kra–Dai peoples or Kra–Dai-speaking peoples refers collectively to the ethnic groups of southern China and Southeast Asia, stretching from Hainan to Northeast India and from southern Sichuan to Laos, Thailand and parts of Vietnam, who not only speak languages belonging to the Kra–Dai language family, but also share similar traditions, culture and ancestry. title: Cao Miao language — Grokipedia
text: Cao Miao is characterized by a tonal system with six distinct tones, which play a crucial role in distinguishing meaning, and it features typical Kra-Dai traits such as monosyllabic roots and analytic syntax. [4]
